questions: What is feedback?
If the feedback is positive, does that mean it is good?
What is a budget?
If the budget is used up, can you keep spending?
What is an inventory?
If the inventory goes down, is there less left?
What is an anomaly?
If the anomaly disappears, is everything normal again?
What is a sink?
If the sink is full, does it stop taking anything in?
What is a scenario?
Does a scenario tell you exactly what will happen?
What is commitment?
Once a commitment is made, can it be undone immediately?
What is a threshold?
After you cross a threshold, can you always just go back?
What is a footprint?
If a footprint gets smaller, did something physically shrink?
What is a pulse?
When a pulse ends, is its effect over?
What is warming?
If warming stops, does everything cool right away?
What is a return period?
If the return period is long, does it have to wait that long before coming back?
What is attribution?
If the attribution changes, does the original source lose credit?
What is an ensemble?
If ensemble members disagree, does that mean one of them is wrong?
What is an emission?
If an emission stops, does the air clear immediately?
